items.note: The prompt never mentions the July Pro price increase from 49 to 69 USD or asks whether it drove Pro churn. It only asks generally what's going on.
It doesn't say to exclude trial accounts (is_trial = yes).
It doesn't say to exclude internal test accounts with emails ending in @ourco.test.
It never defines churn as an account having a cancel_month.
It doesn't say the audience is the CEO.
It doesn't ask for a summary of at most 5 bullets.
It doesn't ask for one suggested chart.
It doesn't ask how confident the conclusion is given the small sample.
